from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maximumSetSize(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums1)
        half = n // 2
        s1 = set(nums1)
        s2 = set(nums2)
        A = len(s1)
        B = len(s2)
        C = len(s1 & s2)
        onlyA = A - C
        onlyB = B - C
        keepA = min(A, half)
        keepB = min(B, half)
        sharedA = max(0, keepA - onlyA)
        sharedB = max(0, keepB - onlyB)
        overlap = max(0, sharedA + sharedB - C)
        return keepA + keepB - overlap

class Solution:
    def maximumSetSize(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums1)
        k = n // 2
        s1 = set(nums1)
        s2 = set(nums2)
        d1 = len(s1)
        d2 = len(s2)
        c = len(s1 & s2)
        union = d1 + d2 - c
        keep1 = min(d1, k)
        keep2 = min(d2, k)
        overlap = max(0, keep1 + keep2 - union)
        return keep1 + keep2 - overlap
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maximumSetSize(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums1)
        half = n // 2
        s1 = set(nums1)
        s2 = set(nums2)
        both = len(s1 & s2)
        only1 = len(s1 - s2)
        only2 = len(s2 - s1)
        take1 = min(only1, half)
        take2 = min(only2, half)
        rem = min(both, (half - take1) + (half - take2))
        return take1 + take2 + rem
class Solution:
    def maximumSetSize(self, nums1, nums2):
        n = len(nums1)
        half = n // 2
        s1 = set(nums1)
        s2 = set(nums2)
        a = min(len(s1), half)
        b = min(len(s2), half)
        c = len(s1 | s2)
        return min(a + b, c)
